title: Tabs and Accordions
summary: Tabs switch between peer views; accordions reveal optional content within a page.

MUST.text: Use tabs for peer sections sharing context; accordions for secondary optional details.
Implement the APG keyboard model: Tab to the tablist, Arrow keys between tabs, Enter/Space to activate, Home/End.
Expose state with role="tab", aria-selected, aria-controls and role="tabpanel" with aria-labelledby; accordions use aria-expanded/aria-controls.

SHOULD.text: Keep tab labels short and parallel; avoid tabs for primary site navigation.
Preserve scroll position and focus when switching tabs where appropriate.

AVOID.text: Do not use tabs as primary site navigation or hide essential instructions in collapsed panels.
Do not implement tabs without keyboard support or with positive tabindex.

EXAMPLE.good: Profile/Security/Notifications tabs with arrow-key navigation; FAQ in an accordion
EXAMPLE.bad: tabs used as site nav; collapsed panel hiding required instructions

FAILURE_MODES: Missing keyboard support blocks tab navigation.
Hidden essential content in accordions causes task failure.
State not exposed to assistive tech (aria-selected/expanded).
